description: Live daily exchange rates from the Frankfurter API (central bank data, no API key). The URL asks for every day since 1 January 2026, so the chart gains a new point each working day. The response is already a flat list of records (date, base, quote, rate), so no 'property' is needed.

title.subtitle: Daily exchange rates, 2026. Source: Frankfurter API (European Central Bank and other central banks)
